meta.title: Terms and Conditions
meta.description: Please read the terms and conditions for using Sewalo services.

content.text: Effective Date: Baisakh 1, 2083

Welcome to Sewalo, a digital platform designed to connect customers with skilled service providers across Nepal. These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your access and use of Sewalo, whether as a service provider (as defined below) or a customer (as defined below). Please read these Terms carefully. By creating an account and using the Service (as defined below), you agree that you have read, understood, accepted and agreed with the Terms which are applicable to you. These terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and Edgeoft Technology Pvt.Ltd. (the "Company"). If you do not agree to or fall within the Terms of the Service and wish to discontinue using this Application or Service, please do not continue using this Application or Service.

To access and use the Service, you must accept the Terms and Conditions outlined below. By using the application provided by the Company (the "Application"), and by downloading, installing, or using any related software provided by the Company (the "Software"), you expressly acknowledge and agree to comply with these Terms and Conditions, along with any future amendments or modifications that may be published periodically through the Application.

Sewalo is an online marketplace that links reliable local service providers with individuals seeking their expertise. Whether you need an electrician, graphic designer, plumber, yoga instructor, or tutor, Sewalo simplifies the process of discovering, booking, and confidently choosing the right professional. All providers are verified, services are locally based, and the platform is founded on trust.

items: "Platform" refers to Sewalo's web and mobile services.
"Customer" refers to any individual seeking services.
"Provider" refers to freelancers, businesses, or individuals offering services.
"User" refers to both Customers and Providers.
"Services" refer to the professional tasks listed and provided via Sewalo.

content.text: By using the Service and/or Platform, you represent, warrant and undertake that:

items: You are legally entitled to accept and agree to the Terms and Conditions and that you are at least eighteen (18) years old. The service is not available to persons under the age of eighteen (18) or such persons that are forbidden for any reason whatsoever to enter into a contractual relationship as provisioned by the Contract law of Nepal;
You are a Nepalese resident or legal entity registered in Nepal and when using the Service you agree to comply with all applicable laws of Nepal;

You will provide true, accurate, not misleading, current and complete information as required for the Service and undertake the responsibility to maintain and update your information in a timely manner to keep it true, accurate, not misleading, current and complete at all times during the term of the Agreement. You agree that Sewalo may rely on your information as true, accurate, not misleading, current and complete. You acknowledge that if your information is untrue, inaccurate, misleading, not current or incomplete in any respect, Sewalo has the right but not the obligation to terminate this Agreement and your use of the Service at any time with or without notice;

Your use of the Service is for your own sole, personal use. You undertake not to authorize others to use your identity or user status, and you may not assign or otherwise transfer your user account to any other person or entity;
You will provide us with whatever proof of identity or any other documents, including but not limited to National ID Card, permits, licenses or approvals which we may reasonably request or require;

You, as the service provider, hold all necessary licenses, certificates, and authorizations required to lawfully provide and operate your services, and possess the requisite approvals and authority to conduct such operations;

You must not engage in any activity intended to deceive the Company or gain personal benefit by any means, whether fraudulent or otherwise, including but not limited to any event, promotion, or campaign organized by the Company to promote new subscriptions or usage of the Service.

As the service provider, you acknowledge that standard telecommunication charges may apply when responding to customer requests for your services, and you shall be solely responsible for bearing such costs.
As the service provider, you agree that the Service is provided on a reasonable effort basis;
You agree that your use of the Service will be subject to the Sewalo Policies as may be amended from time to time;
You agree to assist Sewalo with any internal or external investigations as may be required by Sewalo in complying with any prevailing laws or regulations in place;
You agree to assume full responsibility and liability for all loss or damage suffered by yourself, Sewalo or any other party as a result of your breach of this Agreement;
You shall provide accurate, complete, and up-to-date information at all times.
You shall maintain the security and confidentiality of your account credentials, including your password and any identification or access credentials provided to you for use of the Service.
You shall not impersonate any person or entity, nor create multiple, false, or misleading user accounts.
You agree to immediately notify Sewalo of any unauthorized use of your account or any suspected breach of security.

Sewalo may require users to verify their email address or mobile number through a one-time password (OTP), either during registration or when performing key actions, including but not limited to logging in using a phone number, booking a service, or posting a service.

content.text: Users agree to:

items: Utilize Sewalo exclusively for lawful and legitimate purposes;
Refrain from uploading, transmitting, or storing any content or material that is offensive, defamatory, inaccurate, or misleading;
Refrain from engaging in any form of harassment, fraudulent activity, disrespectful conduct, or any behavior that causes inconvenience or nuisance to Sewalo or any third party;
Adhere to community guidelines and maintain professional ethics at all times;
As a service provider, you shall not contact Consumers for any purpose unrelated to the provision of the Service, and the same restriction shall apply vice versa.

content.text: Users may be shown profile completion progress or gentle reminders to upload verification documents. Completing your profile helps increase credibility and visibility.

Sewalo does not currently provide an in-app messaging or communication feature between Customers and Service Providers. Any communication between Users conducted outside the platform shall be undertaken at the Users' sole discretion and risk. Any in-app communication features introduced in the future shall be subject to revised or updated terms and conditions.
You hereby acknowledge and consent to the Company's collection, use, and processing of your personal information for the purposes and in the manner outlined below.

For the purposes of this Agreement, "Personal Data" refers to any information that can identify you, either directly or indirectly. This includes, but is not limited to, your name, identification number, passport number, nationality, address, contact number, gender, date of birth, and email address, as well as any details you have submitted to the Company through registration forms, applications, or similar documents. It also encompasses information that the Company may collect, store, or process from time to time, including sensitive data such as details concerning your health, religious beliefs, or comparable personal attributes.

Providing your Personal Data is entirely voluntary. However, failure to do so may result in an incomplete application, preventing the Company from processing your information for the purposes stated below and potentially restricting your access to the Service.
The Company may collect, use, and process your Personal Data in connection with its operations and activities, which include, but are not limited to, the following purposes ("the Purpose"):

items: To perform the Company's obligations in respect of any contract entered into with you;
To provide you with any services pursuant to the Terms and Conditions herein;
Process, manage or verify your application for the Service pursuant to the Terms and Conditions herein;
To develop, enhance and provide what is required pursuant to the Terms and Conditions herein to meet your needs;
To facilitate or enable any checks as may be required pursuant to the Terms and Conditions herein;
To respond to questions, comments and feedback from you;
To communicate with you for any of the purposes listed herein;
For the purposes of detection, prevention and prosecution of crime;
For the Company to comply with its obligations under law;
To send you alerts, newsletters, updates, mailers, promotional materials, special privileges, festive greetings from the Company, its partners, advertisers, and/or sponsors;

content.text: If you do not agree to the Company processing your Personal Data for any of the stated purposes, you are requested to inform Sewalo through the support contact information provided in the Application.

In the event that any of your Personal Data changes—such as your email address, contact number, payment information—or if you wish to terminate your account, please notify the Company by submitting an update request using the same support contact details available in the Application. The Company will make reasonable efforts to implement the requested changes within fourteen (14) working days from the date of receiving your notice.
By providing your information, you acknowledge and agree that it may be used in accordance with the terms outlined in the submission form and this Agreement.

All fees charged by the Company for the use of the Service (the "Service Fee") shall be due and payable immediately upon accrual and shall be strictly non-refundable. This no-refund policy shall remain in effect under all circumstances, including but not limited to your decision to discontinue use of the Service, the Company's decision to suspend or terminate your access, or any disruption to the Service, whether planned, accidental, intentional, or arising from any other cause.
Customers agree to pay for services in accordance with the prices listed on the platform.

The estimated fee for a service may be determined based on prevailing market demand. Once the fee has been finalized and mutually agreed upon between the Customer and the Service Provider, Sewalo shall bear no responsibility or liability for any subsequent modification, revision, or adjustment to the agreed-upon charge.

Sewalo has partnered with its authorized payment service provider, eSewa. Under the current version of the Sewalo platform, all payments shall be made either directly between the Customer and the Service Provider or through the payment gateway made available on the Sewalo website in partnership with eSewa.
Any dispute relating to a service shall be reported within twenty-four (24) hours of the completion of the service.

Service Providers may update the status of a service through in-app indicators, including but not limited to "Started" or "Completed." Customers are encouraged to verify the completion of the service prior to confirming payment, where applicable.

content.text: Customers and Service Providers who connect through Sewalo agree to continue booking future services via the platform. Users must not arrange services privately, share direct contact information, or bypass Sewalo for payments or scheduling. Violations may result in account suspension or removal.

Service Providers and Customers are required to communicate in a timely and reasonable manner regarding any delays, rescheduling, or cancellations of services. Sewalo may, at its discretion, facilitate or intervene in dispute resolution; however, it does not warrant or guarantee refunds unless expressly stated otherwise in its policies or required by applicable law.

items: Customers may submit reviews based solely on their genuine and actual experiences with a service.
Service Providers shall not manipulate, influence, fabricate, or exchange reviews, ratings, or feedback in any manner.
Sewalo reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to remove or moderate any review that is abusive, misleading, fraudulent, or otherwise in violation of applicable laws or platform policies.
Sewalo encourages Users to provide authentic and honest feedback after a service has been marked as completed.
Reviews and feedback may be publicly visible to other Users and may be used by Sewalo to promote transparency, trust, and service quality on the platform.

content.text: Sewalo may send notifications to Users through in-app messages (including toast notifications), short message service (SMS), or email for the purpose of informing them of important events, including but not limited to bookings, verification requests, and account-related updates. Users may manage their notification preferences through the account settings, where applicable.
Repeated failure to verify account information or misuse of referral or incentive programs may result in the suspension of a User's account.
Sewalo reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to suspend or terminate any account that:

engages in fraudulent, abusive, unlawful, or otherwise prohibited activities.

content.text: Sewalo shall charge a commission of fifteen percent (15%) on the total amount earned by Service Providers for each successfully completed booking. Such commission is levied to support the operation, maintenance, user support services, and continued development of the platform.

Commission amounts payable to the Company shall be accumulated in the Service Provider's account. The Service Provider shall be obligated to remit such accumulated commission to the Company accordingly. Upon the total outstanding commission reaching NPR 500, the Service Provider must settle the payable amount with Sewalo.
In the event that the Service Provider fails to clear the outstanding commission upon reaching this threshold, Sewalo reserves the right:

items: To temporarily restrict the Service Provider from receiving new bookings;
To hide or deprioritize the Service Provider's services in search results, and/or;
To suspend the Service Provider's account until all outstanding dues are fully settled.

content.text: Sewalo reserves the right to amend or revise its commission policies, including applicable rates or thresholds, from time to time. Any such changes shall be communicated to the Service Provider in advance.
